title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1986-04-18
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; Sennheiser MD421's (PAS/Section CTR, Row MM, Seat 15/6 Feet High)> Sony TC-D5M, Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR Out)>Tascam HD-P2 @ 24/48> HDD>Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44 By Keo; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Clear, front‑of‑house recording of a stormy, loose set with strong licks but uneven Garcia navigation.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the four‑night run with loud, crystal‑clear sound and especially crisp drumming, making it easy to relive the shows. Musically the performance is described as stormy and loose – there are several great guitar licks, yet Jerry Garcia’s navigation feels inconsistent. Overall listeners get a solid listening experience despite the occasional musical wobble.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gave 5 stars praising the recording, another gave 3 stars noting uneven playing; combined with good sound quality but mixed musical performance leads to an overall 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Loud and clear front‑of‑house capture, crisp drum detail, no major distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Stormy and loose performance with occasional great licks but inconsistent navigation by Garcia.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great licks noted, but his navigation was described as not very good.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming captured loudly and clearly in the recording.
